text:
sara: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a 2-week beta feedback sprint for the 'Preview: FinServe' cohort starting Mon. Need final enrollment list, kickoff deck + who can run onboarding sessions?

matt: I'll share the roster in a sec. We have 5 customers in trial, 3 confirmed for onboarding sessions this week. Risk: one account (GammaBank) low activity last 7 days.

devon: I can run two walk-through sessions (Tues 11am, Thurs 4pm PT). I'll use the lightweight runbook: https://redwood-internal/docs/beta/onboarding-runbook

nora: Product asks — what telemetry do we want from these sessions? priority: latency heatmap, error rates, and a usage tag for 'beta-finserve'. I'll add an event spec and a small SDK snippet.

nora: Snippet for tagging events:

```js
client.analytics.track({
  event: 'inference_request',
  props: { model: 'finserve-v1', cohort: 'beta-finserve' }
});
```

sara: Awesome. matt — can you ping GammaBank's CSM and flag them as 'at-risk' if no activity by Fri? Also we need to email all participants the feedback form after session 1.

matt: @sara yep, pinged CSM (cc @devon) and scheduled a short re-engage call Fri EOD. Also drafting the feedback form (2 min, 8 questions) — will post link here when ready.

beta-bot: Enrollment confirmed for 3 customers: AlphaPay, BetaLedger, GammaBank. Reminder: kickoff deck auto-sent 24h before session.

devon: Feedback form draft: https://forms.gle/abc123 — focuses on accuracy, latency, integration friction. Please add 1 question you'd like product to see.

nora: Add: "Did you need to fall back to a simpler model or cached response during the session?" (Yes/No + short text)

sara: Nice. Action items:
- matt: finalize roster + flag GammaBank by Fri
- devon: run sessions Tues/Thurs + capture notes
- nora: push telemetry spec and add question
- everyone: please review form & kickoff deck by EOD tomorrow

matt: noted. I'll post final roster and the email template by 6pm today. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks team — we'll reconvene after first session for a quick retrospective (15m). If possible, record the session and drop the recording here.

beta-bot: Session recordings auto-upload to /shared/beta/finserve/recordings when available.

sara: Closing loop — tagging @nora @devon @matt. Anything else? Otherwise I'll create the calendar invites.

matt: all good from me.

devon: good to go.

nora: good :tada:
